A [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|Sarkhai]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''cousin''' of [[Nadia Grell]] who lived on the<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Sarkhai">{{TORcite|type=codex|Sarkhai (Consular)}}</ref> [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She was the niece of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] and the cousin of his daughter [[Nadia Grell]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
